sql: WITH RECURSIVE months(m) AS (SELECT '2020-01-01' UNION ALL SELECT date(m,'+1 month') FROM months WHERE m<'2020-12-01'), customers AS (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer_nodes), net AS (SELECT customer_id,date(txn_date,'start of month') m,SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type='deposit' THEN txn_amount WHEN txn_type='withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount ELSE 0 END) balance FROM customer_transactions WHERE txn_date>='2020-01-01' AND txn_date<'2021-01-01' GROUP BY customer_id,m), spine AS (SELECT c.customer_id,m.m,COALESCE(n.balance,0) balance FROM customers c CROSS JOIN months m LEFT JOIN net n ON n.customer_id=c.customer_id AND n.m=m.m), stats AS (SELECT m,SUM(balance>0) positive_customers,AVG(balance) avg_balance,SUM(balance) total_net FROM spine GROUP BY m) SELECT * FROM stats ORDER BY m
